item.title: Election Commission: "Of 50 locations with ballot shortages, 22 had waiting voters" – numbers may increase (선관위 “용지 부족 50곳 중 투표 대기 22곳”…더 늘어날 수도)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) reported to the Reform Party on the 8th that a total of 50 polling stations experienced ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, and among them, 22 locations had voters who had to wait to cast their ballots. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 때 투표용지 부족 사태가 총 50개 투표소에서 발생했으며, 이 가운데 실제로 투표자가 대기해서 투표해야 했던 곳은 22곳이었다고 개혁신당에 8일 보고했다.)

Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day and stated, "I received a briefing this morning from the Deputy Secretary-General of the NEC regarding the actual situation of the ballot shortage." He added, "This is based on data as of the 5th, and the numbers could increase further." (천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “오늘 오전 중앙선관위 사무차장으로부터 투표 용지 부족 사태와 관련한 실태를 보고 받았다”며 이렇게 전했다. 그는 “이는 지난 5일 기준으로 파악된 것이고, 추후 더 늘어날 수 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

According to the NEC report, additional ballots were sent to 67 polling stations nationwide due to concerns of shortages. Among these, actual shortages occurred at 50 locations, while 17 were found to have had "ballots sent additionally even though there was no shortage." The 50 locations with actual shortages were: 33 in Seoul, 3 in Busan, 4 in Daegu, 6 in Incheon, 2 in Ulsan, and 2 in South Gyeongsang Province. The 22 polling stations with waiting voters were in Seoul's Songpa (12 locations), Gangnam (4), Gwangjin (2), Seocho (1), and Incheon's Yeonsu-gu (3). (중앙선관위 보고 내용을 보면, 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 추가로 용지를 송부했던 투표소는 전국에 67곳이었다. 이 가운데 실제 50곳에서 실제로 투표용지 부족이 발생했고, 17곳은 ‘투표용지는 부족하지 않았으나 용지를 추가 송부한 곳'으로 나타났다. 투표용지 부족이 실제로 발생한 50곳은 서울 33곳, 부산 3곳, 대구 4곳, 인천 6곳, 울산 2곳, 경남 2곳이다. 대기가 발생한 투표소 22곳은 서울 송파(12곳)·강남(4곳)·광진(2곳)·서초(1곳), 인천 연수구(3곳)이다.)

The NEC also confirmed that the ballot shortage issue came to light only after receiving a complaint call at 4:25 PM on election day from polling station No. 3 in Garak 2-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul. This was after additional ballots had been sent to polling station No. 7 in Jamsil 4-dong, Songpa-gu, at around 2:20 PM due to concerns of a shortage. (중앙선관위는 또, 투표용지 부족 사태를 선거 당일 오후 4시25분 서울 송파구 가락2동 제3투표소의 민원인 전화를 받고야 알게된 것으로 파악됐다. 당시 오후 2시20분께 송파구 잠실4동 제7투표소에서 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 투표용지가 송부된 이후다.)

Floor leader Cheon stated, "It was reported that extending the voting deadline at polling stations where voting was not properly conducted to 10 PM on the same day was decided solely by the chairperson of the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission, and no subsequent approval was made by either the Seoul Metropolitan or National Election Commission." (천 원내대표는 “투표가 제대로 이뤄지지 못한 투표소의 투표 마감을 당일 오후 10시까지 연장한 것도 서울시선관위원장이 단독으로 결정했으며, 사후에라도 서울시선관위 또는 중앙선관위 의결이 이뤄지진 않은 것으로 보고됐다”고 밝혔다.)

The Reform Party argued for "selective re-elections" at polling stations where ballots actually ran short and announced that they would file a "petition for the invalidation of some elections within Seoul due to the ballot shortage." According to the Public Official Election Act, for local elections, to invalidate an election and hold a re-election, one must first file an election appeal with the higher-level election commission, and if dissatisfied with the commission's decision, a lawsuit can be filed in court. (개혁신당은 실제로 투표용지가 부족했던 투표소에서 ’선별적 재선거'를 치를 것을 주장하며, 이를 위해 ‘투표용지 부족 사태에 따른 서울 관내 선거 일부 무효 소청'을 제기하겠다고 밝혔다. 공직선거법은 지방선거의 경우 선거 무효와 이에 따른 재선거를 하려면, 먼저 상급선관위에 선거소청을 하고, 선관위가 이에 불복할 시 법원에 소송을 할 수 있도록 규정하고 있다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr and Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: “The election is a warning from the people… I wasn’t in great shape for two or three days either.” (이 대통령 “선거, 국민의 경고…저도 2~3일 상태 별로 안 좋았다”)
item.description:
“Now there’s one more thing I want to talk about—the election. You all might be curious, and it’s something I want to discuss too.” (“이제 (하고 싶은 이야기가) 하나 남았어요. 선거 얘기. 여러분도 궁금하겠지만, 저도 하고 싶은 얘기죠.”)

President Lee Jae-myung held a press conference marking his first year in office at 10 a.m. on the 8th at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, showcasing his characteristic candid and unfiltered style. President Lee, who had been waiting for election-related questions, began his response to a query about “how would you assess the June 3 local elections?” by saying, “Honestly, this question is unavoidable, so I put a lot of thought into it. What should I say?” He then shared his thoughts on the election results for about 12 minutes and 50 seconds. President Lee stated, “Though some truly inexplicable situations unfolded, even that is a warning from our people to me or to this administration,” adding, “For about two or three days, I wasn’t in very good shape either.” <<> Regarding the Samsung Electronics union demanding a share of excess profit bonuses, President Lee said, “I couldn’t imagine demanding a cut of operating profits. Isn’t that quite cheeky?” He also explained real estate policy, remarking, “When a conservative government takes power, they perform rites to boost property prices, but they don’t rise. These issues pile up over years, and then when a reform government comes in, prices suddenly soar.” <<> The press conference on that day lasted 167 minutes, far exceeding the scheduled 90 minutes, ending at 12:47 p.m. During the press conference, two college students who were former reporters for university media also asked questions about youth and regional policies. <<> Meanwhile, President Lee wore a tie with white and sky-blue stripes on that day, just as he did during the National Appointment Ceremony on August 15 last year. An official from Cheong Wa Dae explained, “It signifies a commitment not to lose sight of the original intention and a hopeful South Korea.” <<> Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr <<> (이재명 대통령은 8일 오전 10시 청와대 영빈관에서 취임 1주년 기자회견을 열고 특유의 솔직하고 가감 없는 화법을 보였다. 선거 질문을 기다렸다는 이 대통령은 ‘6·3 지방선거 결과를 어떻게 평가하냐’는 질문에 “사실 이 질문은 피할 수 없는 거라 고민을 되게 많이 했다. 뭐라고 해야 하나”라고 운을 뗐다. 이어 약 12분 50초 동안 선거 결과 등에 대한 생각을 털어놨다. 이 대통령은 “도대체 납득할 수 없는 상황이 벌어지긴 했지만, 그조차도 우리 국민이 저에게 또는 이 정권에 보낸 경고”라며 “한 2~3일은 저도 상태가 별로 그렇게 좋지 않았다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook cites Kortis’ "Leap Over the Fence" as resolve… On her way to the hearing preparation office (한성숙, 코르티스 “넘어가 울타리” 인용한 각오…인사청문 사무실 출근길)
item.description:
Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook stated on the 8th, "If I am entrusted with the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister, I will first focus all my efforts on overcoming the current urgent livelihood and economic crisis." (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 8일 “제가 국무총리의 중책을 맡게 된다면 먼저 당면한 민생경제 비상 상황을 타개하는 데 총력을 기울이겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Han made this remark while meeting with reporters as she arrived at the hearing preparation office set up at the Financial Supervisory Service training center in Tongui-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, saying, "I feel a tremendous sense of responsibility for being nominated as the Prime Minister candidate at this transitional time as the government enters its second year." (한 후보자는 이날 서울 종로구 통의동 금융감독원 연수원에 마련된 인사청문회 준비 사무실로 출근하면서 기자들과 만나 “정부 출범 2년차를 맞이하는 전환적인 시기에 국무총리 후보자로 지명받은 것에 대해 굉장히 무거운 책임감을 느낀다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Han added, "Under the accelerated industrial restructuring driven by artificial intelligence (AI) and the global complex crisis, I will accelerate the AI transformation and focus on speeding up innovation. We must also achieve a structural shift where the fruits of this effort lead to opportunities and growth for all citizens of the Republic of Korea," and "I will give my all with a sense of mission." <<> When asked about her resolve to take on the role of Prime Minister, Han also mentioned the lyrics of the idol group Kortis. She said, "The lyrics from Kortis’ song— 'Don’t hold back, red red, the traffic light has changed, green green, leap over the fence, green green'—resonated with me. I will give my best to not hold back, to adapt to the changing times as the traffic lights change, and to boldly leap over fences wherever possible." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (한 후보자는 “에이아이(AI·인공지능)로 가속화되는 산업 재편과 글로벌 복합 위기 상황하에서 에이아이 대전환에 박차를 가하고, 혁신을 가속화하는 데 집중하겠다. 그 과실이 대한민국 국민 모두의 기회와 성장으로 이어지는 구조의 전환도 이뤄가야 한다”며 “사명감을 가지고 사력을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "With the Mindset that Every Day is the Last, I Will Create an 'Irreplaceable Republic of Korea'" (이 대통령 “매일이 마지막날이란 심정으로 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’ 만들겠다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 8th presented the "Irreplaceable Republic of Korea" as the national vision for the second year of his administration. As the four national goals to realize this, he highlighted a super-gap industrial powerhouse, a diplomatic and security powerhouse, a normal society, and a government that saves lives. (이재명 대통령이 8일 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’을 집권 2년차 국정 비전으로 제시했다. 이를 실현하기 위한 4가지 국정 목표로는 초격차 산업 강국, 외교·안보 강국, 정상사회, 목숨 살리는 정부를 꼽았다.)

In his opening remarks at a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee stated, "I will make 2026 the year when the bold dream of an 'Irreplaceable Republic of Korea,' which no other country in the world can substitute, begins." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 연 취임 1주년 기자회견 머리발언에서 “2026년 올해를 세계 어떤 나라도 대신할 수 없는 ‘대체 불가 대한민국’의 담대한 꿈이 시작되는 해로 만들겠다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

President Lee first said, "We will advance toward a super-gap industrial powerhouse where all citizens and the entire nation equally enjoy the opportunities and benefits of growth," adding, "By pooling all the capabilities of the government and the private sector, we will secure overwhelming competitiveness in cutting-edge technology fields." He further noted, "What is most important is that the fruits of growth should not remain confined to specific companies, specific regions, or specific sectors," and "We will soon unveil a large-scale investment project to the public that will achieve a 'grand transformation of growth strategy.'" (이 대통령은 먼저 “모든 국민과 국토가 성장의 기회와 혜택을 고루 누리는 초격차 산업 강국으로 나아가겠다”며 “정부와 민간의 역량을 총결집해, 첨단기술 분야의 압도적 경쟁력을 확보해나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “무엇보다 중요한 것은 성장의 과실이 특정 기업, 특정 지역, 특정 부문에 머물러서는 안 된다는 것”이라며 “조만간 ‘성장 전략의 대전환’을 이뤄낼 대규모 투자 프로젝트를 국민 앞에 공개할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, President Lee stated, "We will move toward being a global diplomatic and security powerhouse that protects the peace and pride of all citizens," and "We will do our utmost to ensure that the valuable diplomatic and security achievements made over the past year—such as revising the ROK-U.S. nuclear agreement, introducing nuclear submarines, and pursuing the early recovery of wartime operational control—bear concrete fruit." President Lee also expressed his determination to create "a normal society where norms and rules agreed upon by all citizens are faithfully upheld" and "a government that saves the lives of the people." (또 이 대통령은 “국민 모두의 평화와 자부심을 지키는 글로벌 외교·안보 강국으로 나아가겠다”며 “한-미 원자력협정 개정, 핵잠수함 도입, 조기 전시작전통제권 회복 추진 등 지난 1년간 만들어낸 외교 안보의 귀중한 성과들이 구체적 결실로 맺어지도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “국민 모두가 합의한 규범과 규칙이 확실히 지켜지는 정상사회”와 “국민의 목숨을 살리는 정부”를 만들겠다는 의지도 내비쳤다.)

President Lee said, "With the mindset that every day given to me is the last day of my term, I will give my all to run," and "I will fulfill my given mission with a heavier sense of responsibility than over the past year." (이 대통령은 “저에게 주어진 하루하루가 임기 마지막 날이라는 심정으로, 죽을힘을 다해 뛰겠다”며 “지난 1년보다 더 무거운 책임감으로 주어진 사명을 이행하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: On ROK-Japan Military Logistics Agreement, Told PM Takaichi, "It's Difficult Now" (이 대통령 “한일 군수지원협정, 다카이치 총리에 ‘현재는 어렵다’ 얘기”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated at a press conference marking his first year in office on the 8th that regarding the ROK-Japan Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement (ACSA), he "told Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae that given the public sentiment, it's difficult to accept this at present." This is the first official confirmation that South Korea and Japan discussed ACSA during their summit. ACSA is an agreement that allows the two countries to exchange military supplies such as ammunition, food, and fuel. While Japan has strongly pushed for its conclusion, South Korea has maintained a cautious stance, saying it is "not considering it." <<> At the press conference held at Cheong Wa Dae's Yeongbin-gwan, when a Japanese journalist asked about ACSA, President Lee explained, "Right now, the people of South Korea think, 'What is this about?'" and added, "As I see it, there is a practical need for it. But I told Prime Minister Takaichi, 'If I bring this up, I'll be in trouble. Please understand our position.'" <<> President Lee's mention of "practical need" draws attention. It appears to reflect the recognition that since seven rear bases of the United Nations Command are located in Japan, Japan's cooperation and support are necessary for smooth military logistics in the event of a contingency on the Korean Peninsula, and ACSA would institutionally underpin this. <<> "Public sentiment" refers to the strong concern that "we, who have experienced the pain of Japanese colonial rule, cannot tolerate opening the door for the Japan Self-Defense Forces to legally enter the Korean Peninsula." If ACSA institutionally guarantees Japan's military support in the event of a contingency on the Korean Peninsula, it would create conditions for Japanese Self-Defense Force vessels or transport aircraft to be dispatched or stationed on the peninsula. <<> President Lee likened the ROK-Japan history issue to an offender and a victim of violence, stating, "Clearly, if someone punched me and I got hit... (Japan) must genuinely apologize, saying 'I'm truly sorry for hitting you.'" This is interpreted to mean that full-fledged bilateral military cooperation, including ACSA, is only possible when Japan offers a sincere apology, building trust between the two countries and resolving the historical issues. <<> In response to a foreign journalist's question about the situation in Israel and the Middle East, President Lee addressed the attack on the South Korean ship *Namuho* in the Strait of Hormuz by an Iranian missile, saying, "If it was an intentional attack, they would declare 'we did it,'" and added, "It's clear it was not intentional." He continued, "In any case, there are various factors, but since we judge it to be an Iranian missile, we have lodged a strong protest with Iran and demanded measures to prevent a recurrence." <<> Regarding his public criticism of Israel's human rights violations through posts on X (formerly Twitter) and comments during a Cabinet meeting, President Lee explained, "It wasn't done out of anger. As the head of state of South Korea, I tried not to speak out, but when I thought it was going too far, I pointed it out." <<> Specifically concerning South Korean activists detained by the Israeli military while participating in a flotilla bound for Gaza, he stated, "Isn't this effectively the kidnapping of our nationals on the high seas, where freedom of navigation is guaranteed?" and added, "In my view, if it involves the human rights of South Korean citizens or the sovereignty of South Korea, it cannot be simply overlooked." <<> By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령은 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 한-일 상호군수지원협정(ACSA·악사)에 대해 “(다카이치 사나에 일본 총리에게) 국민 정서상 이것을 받아들이기가 현재는 어렵다고 얘기했다”고 밝혔다. 한국과 일본이 정상회담에서 악사를 논의한 사실 자체를 공식 확인한 것은 처음이다. 악사는 양국이 탄약과 식량, 연료 등 군수물자를 주고받을 수 있는 협정이다. 일본은 체결을 강하게 원하고 있지만 한국은 “검토하지 않고 있다”는 신중한 입장이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "North Korea Is Producing Nuclear Material Even Now…We Must Engage in Dialogue with Short-, Mid-, and Long-Term Goals" (이 대통령 “북, 이 순간에도 핵물질 생산…단기·중기·장기 목표로 대화해야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 8th, "North Korea is producing nuclear material even now," and emphasized that dialogue on North Korea's nuclear issue should be pursued with short-, mid-, and long-term objectives. (이재명 대통령이 8일 “북한은 이 순간에도 핵물질을 생산하고 있다”며 단기·중기·장기적 목표를 갖고 북핵 대화를 해야 한다고 말했다.)

During a press conference marking his first anniversary in office held at the Cheong Wa Dae Guest House, President Lee addressed the North Korean nuclear issue, saying, "I believe we must not be fixated on either reality or ideals alone." He added, "North Korea is increasing its nuclear weapons, and its intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) technology is approaching completion. The situation is getting worse. Even just halting this progress would benefit the international community and the Korean Peninsula." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 연 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 북핵 문제와 관련해 “현실과 이상 한 쪽에 매몰되면 안 된다고 생각한다”며 “북한은 핵무기가 늘어나고, 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM) 기술은 완료 단계를 향해 가고 있다. (상황이) 더욱 나빠지고 있다. (이를) 중단시키는 것만 해도 국제사회나 한반도에 도움이 된다”고 말했다.)

President Lee proposed, "We should set short-term negotiation goals: stopping additional nuclear material production, preventing the export of nuclear material (moratorium), and halting ICBM technology development." He warned, "If we say this means abandoning denuclearization, we would be neglecting reality and creating an even worse situation." Regarding North Korea's nuclear technology, he noted, "If it goes beyond what is necessary for regime survival, they will likely export it," stressing the importance of short-term plans, saying, "Preventing this is also in the international community's interest." (이 대통령은 “핵물질 추가 생산 중단, 핵물질 해외 반출 저지(모라토리엄), 대륙간탄도미사일 기술 개발 중단만 단기 목표로 잡고 협상해야 한다”며 “이걸로 비핵화를 포기했다는 이야기를 하면 현실을 방치해 더 나쁜 상황을 만드는 것”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 북한의 핵 기술을 두고 “체제 유지를 위해 필요한 범위를 넘어서면 (그다음엔) 수출하게 될 것”이라며 “이걸 막는 것도 국제사회의 이익”이라며 단기적 계획의 필요성을 강조했다.)

On the argument for South Korea's own nuclear armament, he called it "truly irresponsible talk" and expressed concerns about a domino effect of nuclear armament among East Asian countries like Japan and Taiwan. He added, "South Korea is a country highly dependent on foreign relations. We cannot live under international sanctions (from pursuing nuclear weapons)." (국내 핵무장 주장에 대해선 “정말 무책임한 소리”라며 일본과 대만 등 동아시아 국가들의 도미노식 핵무장 가능성을 우려했다. 그는 “대한민국은 대외의존도가 높은 나라다. (핵무장에 따른) 국제 제재를 받으며 살 수 없다”고도 말했다.)

President Lee assessed the current inter-Korean relations as "deteriorated to the point where it cannot get much worse." Nevertheless, he stated, "We cannot abandon the pursuit of peaceful unification, but discussing unification under the current state would worsen relations further, so we must first engage in dialogue for peaceful coexistence." On security, he said, "We need to develop the Korea-U.S. alliance in a forward-looking manner, but that is not everything." The president highlighted the importance of managing relations with Japan, China, and Russia, stating, "In the long term, I believe Northeast Asian security must move toward a complex multilateral security system." (이 대통령은 현재의 남북관계가 “나빠지기 어려울 만큼 나빠져 있다”고 진단했다. 그럼에도 “평화적인 통일의 지향을 포기할 순 없고, 현재 상태에서 통일을 얘기하면 관계가 더 나빠지니 일단 평화 공존을 위해 대화해야 한다”고 했다. 안보와 관련해선 “한미동맹을 미래지향적으로 발전시켜야 하지만 그것만이 전부는 아니”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 일본, 중국, 러시아와의 관계 관리의 중요성을 언급하며 “길게 보면 동북아시아 안보는 복합적인 다자안보 체계로 가야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Na Kyung-won: "We Must Amend the Election Law to Open the Way for a By-Election"... Some in the Party Voice Opposition to Seoul Mayoral By-Election (나경원 “선거법 바꿔 재선거 길 열어야”…당 일각선 “서울시장 재선거 반대”)
item.description:
Lawmakers from the People Power Party have announced plans to push for amendments to the Public Official Election Act to ease the requirements for invalidating an election, in connection with the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections. <<> Lawmaker Na Kyung-won held an emergency debate at the National Assembly on the 8th under the theme "Shortage of Ballot Papers and Poor Election Management: The People Demand a By-Election and a Special Counsel." She stated, "Even from a legal standpoint, under the current Public Official Election Act and existing precedents, it is my conclusion that a by-election is fundamentally difficult to hold in South Korea." She added, "Amending the election law to address the issue of the integrity of election procedures must be the first step." Na continued, "By amending the election law, we intend to open a practical path for a by-election," and noted, "There is also a Constitutional Court ruling that retroactive application is possible in cases where a significant constitutional interest has been infringed upon," indicating the need to consider the possibility of retroactive legislation. <<> Na further pointed out, "Revising the provisions of the Public Official Election Act is the first step toward resolving the National Election Commission's poor management, corruption, and incompetence." She criticized, "The provision that says 'unless it affected the election outcome' creates a problem of proof—how can we calculate voters who were unable to cast their ballots?" Article 224 of the Public Official Election Act stipulates that even if there is a violation of election-related regulations, a decision or ruling to invalidate all or part of an election or the election of a candidate can only be made 'to the extent that it is deemed to have affected the election outcome.' Na appears to have taken issue with this clause. <<> Lawmaker Cho Bae-sook, co-host of the debate, also stated, "If you go to Olympic Park now, you'll see many angry citizens voluntarily coming out to protest. What they are demanding is a by-election." However, she added, "Legally, holding a by-election is not simple. If the political circles fail to properly address the issue of a by-election, I think the disappointment will be great. We need to point out the problems with the current law and come up with improvement measures." <<> The debate was co-hosted by the People Power Party's Policy Committee, and was attended by many party leaders, including party leader Chang Dong-hyuk and former floor leader Song Eon-seok. At the event, Chang emphasized repeatedly, "The Democratic Party of Korea has agreed to accept a special counsel and a parliamentary investigation. While further discussion is needed, the most important, urgent, and priority issue is a by-election." Chang has been advocating for a nationwide by-election. <<> However, some within the party have publicly voiced opposition to a Seoul mayoral by-election. Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop, who served as a co-chair of the joint election committee for Oh Se-hoon's campaign, told reporters on the same day, "To demand a Seoul mayoral by-election, the mayor would have to resign and then request a by-election, but if a three-term mayor resigns, they would be unable to run for a fourth consecutive term." He added, "While we need to actively consider by-elections for Songpa-gu district councilors and Seoul city councilors, and proportional representative seats, I cannot accept a by-election for Mayor Oh." <<> Meanwhile, the Reform Party argued for a 'selective by-election,' proposing that a by-election should be held only for polling stations where voting was actually suspended due to a shortage of ballot papers. The Reform Party submitted a request for preservation of evidence for ballot papers and internal CCTV footage from the National Election Commission on the same day and plans to file an election challenge soon. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (국민의힘 의원들이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 선거 무효 판결 요건을 완화하는 공직선거법 개정을 추진한다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: "An Irreplaceable President Lee," Says Chung Cheong-rae..."No People in Lee Jae-myung's World," Says Jang Dong-hyuk (정청래 “대체불가 이 대통령”…장동혁 “이재명 세상엔 국민 없어”)
item.description:
Regarding President Lee Jae-myung's first-year anniversary press conference, the ruling and opposition parties offered sharply contrasting reactions on the 8th. The Democratic Party of Korea praised it, saying, "It presented aspirations and hope for the future," while the People Power Party criticized it as "a comprehensive package of self-praise and blaming others." (이재명 대통령의 취임 1주년 기자회견에 대해 8일 여야는 상반된 반응을 내놨다. 더불어민주당은 “미래에 대한 포부와 희망을 제시했다”고 평가했지만, 국민의힘은 “자화자찬 남 탓의 종합판”이라고 비판했다.)

Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae posted on Facebook that day, "We could see a leadership strong on details, unlike past presidents," and, borrowing the title of the press conference, 'An Irreplaceable Korea,' he said, "In a word, [he is] 'an irreplaceable President Lee Jae-myung.'" Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae stated at a press briefing at the National Assembly, "The past year was one where, amid various crises in Korea, the nation recovered and turned toward growth. This was a press conference where that assessment was clearly revealed and seen." The Democratic Party leadership watched the press conference together in the party leader's office at the National Assembly after concluding a closed-door supreme council meeting. Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun also said in a written briefing, "The fact that all these processes were achieved together with the people, and the will to continue working with the people in the future, stood out." (정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “역대 대통령과 다른 디테일에 강한 리더십을 볼 수 있었다”며 이날 간담회 제목인 ‘대체불가 대한민국’을 따와 “한마디로 ‘대체불가한 이재명 대통령’”이라고 말했다. 조승래 사무총장은 국회 기자간담회에서 “지난 1년은 대한민국 여러 위기 속에 대한민국이 회복하고 성장으로 전환하는 1년이었다. 그 평가가 잘 드러나고, 또 보인 기자회견”이라고 했다. 민주당 지도부는 비공개 최고위원회의를 마친 뒤 국회 당 대표실에서 함께 기자회견을 지켜봤다. 강준현 수석대변인도 서면브리핑에서 “이 모든 과정을 국민과 함께 이뤄냈다는 사실과 앞으로도 국민과 함께할 것이라는 의지가 돋보였다”고 말했다.)

However, the People Power Party harshly criticized it. (그러나 국민의힘은 혹평했다.)

Leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at an emergency press conference that afternoon, "Not a hint of apology could be found for the people suffering in a real estate hell. There was not a single word of apology to the people who are furious over having their voting rights stripped away." He added, "There are no people in Lee Jae-myung's world. It is truly deplorable." Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon also stated in a comment, "No thorough reflection, accountability, or solutions for the misgovernance of the past year could be found." (장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 긴급 기자회견에서 “부동산 지옥으로 고통받는 국민에 대한 일말의 미안함도 찾아볼 수 없었다. 참정권을 빼앗기고 분노하는 국민에게 단 한마디의 사과도 없었다”며 “이재명의 세상엔 국민이 없다. 실로 참담하다”고 말했다. 박성훈 수석대변인도 논평에서 “지난 1년간의 실정에 대한 처절한 성찰도, 책임도, 해법도 찾아볼 수 없었다”고 말했다.)

Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok criticized President Lee's comment regarding the Iranian missile attack on a South Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz, where the president said, "It was not intentional," accusing him of "protecting Iran more than [his] own government." (이준석 개혁신당 대표는 이 대통령이 호르무즈 해협에서 한국 선박의 이란산 미사일 피격 사건에 대해 “의도를 가진 것은 아니다”는 발언한 데 대해 “자기 정부보다 이란을 더 감싸고 있다”고 비판했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Expresses Discontent with Democratic Party Leadership: "It's Not a Success... Must Be a Vessel" (이 대통령, 민주당 지도부에 불만 “성공 아니다…그릇이 돼야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the June 3 local election results that "at the very least, it was not a success" and told the ruling party that "it must become a vessel (that integrates and embraces)." This is interpreted as a roundabout expression of dissatisfaction with the 'Jeong Cheong-rae leadership,' amid assessments of a 'half victory' despite high approval ratings for the party and government. (이재명 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 결과를 두고 “최소한 성공은 아니다”라며 여당을 향해선 “(통합하고 포용하는) 그릇이 돼야 한다”고 말했다. 높은 당정 지지율에도 ‘반쪽 승리’라는 평가가 나오는 가운데 ‘정청래 지도부’에 대한 불만을 에둘러 드러낸 것으로 풀이된다.)

In a press conference marking his first anniversary in office held at the Cheongwadae State Guest House on the 8th, President Lee shared his reflections on the local election results, saying, "There are many scenes (in the election) that I don't understand." While the Democratic Party of Korea secured 12 out of 16 metropolitan and provincial governorship positions, achieving an apparent victory, the remarks seem mindful of its defeats in key battlegrounds like Seoul, Daegu, and South Gyeongsang Province. This differs somewhat in nuance from the party leadership's assessment, which emphasized a 'nationwide victory.' President Lee expressed regret over the local election results, stating, "Originally, the president is neutral in elections. But it turned out to be hard to maintain a neutral expression." He also shared his feelings, saying, "It's not that I didn't think, 'I worked so hard, I didn't do anything wrong, at least they wouldn't abandon me.' But I think I lacked the mindset to truly give my all, until the very last moment, to speak and persuade even a single sovereign voter." He then humbly added, "For about two or three days, I wasn't in a good state. In the end, I thought it was my own inadequacy." (이 대통령은 8일 청와대 영빈관에서 연 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “(지방선거에서) 이해가 안 되는 장면이 많이 있다”며 지방선거 결과에 대한 소회를 밝혔다. 더불어민주당이 16개 광역자치단체장 가운데 12곳을 차지하며 외견상 승리를 거뒀지만, 서울과 대구, 경남 등 주요 격전지에서 패배한 것을 염두에 둔 발언으로 보인다. ‘전국적인 승리’에 방점을 찍은 당 지도부의 평가와는 다소 결이 다르다. 이 대통령은 “원래 선거에서 (대통령은) 중립이다. 근데 표정은 중립이 잘 안되더라”며 지방선거 결과에 대한 아쉬움을 드러냈다. 이 대통령은 “‘이렇게 열심히 했고, 내가 나쁜 짓 한 것도 아니고, 최소한 뭐 버리기야 하겠어’라는 마음이 없었던 건 아니다”라며 “마지막 한순간까지 단 한명의 주권자까지도 정말 죽을힘을 다해서 말씀드리고 설득하겠다는 마음이 부족하지 않았나 그런 생각이 든다”는 소회를 전하기도 했다. 이어 “한 2~3일 정도 저도 상태가 별로 좋지 않았다. 결론은 저의 부족이라 생각했다”고 몸을 낮췄다.)

President Lee then brought up the 'qualities of the ruling party.' He said, "The opposition party must wield its spear well, but the ruling party must be a vessel," adding, "It needs to do a good job of gathering, integrating, and embracing as many people as possible who have different colors and different thoughts from ours." He continued, "True strength is like the sea. You must be able to accept everything," adding, "If you overemphasize differences, everyone becomes an enemy. In my opinion, things like using extreme language, distinguishing by color, conducting ideological screening, or insulting based on interests should not be done." He also said, "The strength I think of is being firm but gentle on the inside. Being good at swearing doesn't make a strong party." This passage can be interpreted as revealing his perception that the Democratic Party focused more on competing for clarity rather than pursuing integration. A ruling party leadership lawmaker commented, "It wasn't a direct criticism of the leadership, but it seemed like a roundabout criticism." (이어 이 대통령은 ‘여당의 자질’을 거론했다. 이 대통령은 “야당은 창을 잘 써야 되지만 여당은 그릇이 돼야 한다”며 “우리하고 색깔이 다른 사람, 생각이 다른 사람들을 최대한 많이 모아서 통합하고 포용하는 역할을 잘해야 된다”고 했다. 그러면서 “진짜 강한 건 바다 같은 것이다. 다 받을 수 있어야 한다”며 “다름을 막 강조하면 다 적군이 된다. 과격한 표현이나, 색채를 구분한다든지 사상 검열을 한다든지, 이해관계를 갖고 모욕한다든지 이래 버리면 안 된단 게 제 생각”이라고 덧붙였다. “제가 생각하는 강함은 외유내강이다. 욕설을 잘한다고 강한 당이 되지는 않는다”는 말도 했다. 민주당이 통합 행보보단 선명성 경쟁에 치중했다는 인식을 드러낸 것으로 해석할 수 있는 대목이다. 여당 지도부 한 의원은 “지도부에 대해 정면 비판은 아니어도 에둘러 비판한 것 같다”고 했다.)

Inside and outside the Democratic Party, some interpretations emerged that President Lee might have lent support to State Councilor Kim Min-seok, who announced his intention to run for party leadership at the press conference. During the press conference, regarding State Councilor Kim, President Lee said, "With truly outstanding leadership, the cabinet has run fiercely without any major fuss or noise, moving towards a single goal in the direction I set. He did so well, perhaps better than any cabinet that has produced so many concrete results in such a short time." A pro-Kim Jong-un figure said, "It seemed like he wanted to clearly show his opinion regarding the party leadership election. There were parts that could be read that way." A non-mainstream lawmaker commented, "Isn't it a public expression of confidence in State Councilor Kim, effectively lending him support?" (민주당 안팎에선 이 대통령이 기자회견에서 당권 도전 의사를 밝힌 김민석 국무총리에게 힘을 실어준 것 아니냐는 해석도 나왔다. 기자회견에서 이 대통령은 김 총리와 관련해 “정말 뛰어난 리더십으로 내각은 정말 큰 소리, 잡음 없이 하나의 목표를 향해, 제가 제시하는 방향대로 치열하게 잘 달려왔다. 아마 이렇게 단기간 내에 구체적 성과를 많이 낸 내각이 있을까 싶을 정도로 잘해줬다”고 말했다. 한 친청계 인사는 “당대표 선거와 관련해 본인의 의견을 확실하게 보여주고 싶었던 것 같다. 그렇게 읽힐 만한 부분이 있었다”고 했다. 한 비당권파 의원은 “김 총리에 대해서는 공개적으로 신임을 표현하며 힘을 실어준 것 아니겠는가”라고 했다.)

Regarding the background of nominating Han Sung-sook as the new Prime Minister candidate the previous day, President Lee said, "There was considerable deliberation, but in the end, I chose someone who can get the job done," adding, "The party will handle the political elements well. Rather, I intend to ensure that the cabinet can run at full speed with all its strength within the given environment." (이 대통령은 전날 한성숙 국무총리 후보자를 지명한 배경에 대해선 “고민이 적지 않았는데 결론은 일할 사람으로 (정한 것)”이라며 “정치적 요소는 당이 잘 해결해줄 것이다. 오히려 내각은 주어진 환경 속에서 있는 힘을 다해서 전력 질주할 수 있도록 제가 하려고 한다”고 했다.)

On whether there will be a cabinet reshuffle, President Lee stated, "There will be a cabinet reshuffle at an appropriate time and to an appropriate extent." President Lee said, "This cabinet cannot last until the end of my term. It's getting tired and facing many difficulties," adding, "A reshuffle should happen at an appropriate time and scale, but as of now, I haven't carefully and thoroughly examined at what point or to what extent." (개각 여부를 두고 이 대통령은 “적정한 시기에 적정한 규모로 개각이 있을 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “이 내각이 임기 끝까지 갈 수는 없다. 지치기도 하고 힘든 데도 많다”며 “적절한 시기에 적절한 규모로 개각해야 할 텐데 지금으로서는 어느 시점에 어느 정도까지 세심하게, 세밀하게 검토해보지 않았다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Election Results Are a Warning From the People to Me" (이 대통령 “선거 결과, 국민이 제게 준 경고”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 8th regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, "This is a warning from the people," and assessed, "At the very least, it is not a success." Regarding the shortage of ballot papers, he stated, "It has completely ruined all of this model democratic nation, the Republic of Korea, in an instant," and added, "The young people who pointed out the issue are truly precious and worthy of respect." (이재명 대통령이 8일 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 “국민들이 주는 경고”라며 “최소한 성공은 아니다”라고 평가했다. 투표용지 부족 사태에 관해서는 “모범적인 민주국가 대한민국의 이 모든 걸 한순간에 깡그리 망가뜨린 것”이라며 “문제를 지적한 청년들이 참 귀하고 존경할 만하다”고 말했다.)

At a press conference marking the first anniversary of his inauguration held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House on that day, President Lee said of the June 3 local election results, "Though an utterly incomprehensible situation occurred, even that is a warning from our people to me or to this administration." The Democratic Party of Korea won in 12 out of 16 metropolitan mayoral races but lost the Seoul mayoral election. President Lee said, "I have done a great deal of soul-searching," and added, "It is at least not a success. It made me realize that the people are truly a formidable force." However, President Lee stated, "The basic direction of state affairs will not change," and presented the four major national visions for his second year: △ a nation strong in cutting-edge industries, △ a diplomatic and security powerhouse, △ a normal society, and △ a government that saves lives. <<> Regarding the ballot paper shortage, President Lee said, "It is truly absurd and deplorable," and added, "I also reflect a lot on the fact that young people raised it as a fundamental issue concerning the exercise of sovereignty in the democratic republic of Korea." At the Jamsil 7-dong vote counting center, the handball stadium in Olympic Park, Songpa-gu, protests led mainly by young people continue over the ballot paper shortage. President Lee added, "I think the young people who pointed out this issue are truly precious and worthy of respect," and reflected, "I wonder if I lacked 'sovereignty sensitivity.'" <<> Regarding the "Special Counsel for Manipulated Indictments Act," which grants special counsel the authority to revoke indictments, President Lee said, "Just follow the law and common sense. If it's wrong, revoke (the indictment); if not, leave it as is." On the question of granting supplementary investigation powers to prosecutors at the Public Prosecution Service, he stated, "Distrust of the prosecution is too great. There is also some valid concern about what would happen if even that (supplementary investigation power) is abused," and added, "I think it has been settled that this will be handed over to the National Assembly (for discussions on the Criminal Procedure Act)." This marks a shift toward a more negative stance from his remarks at the New Year's press conference in January, where he said, "There are exceptional cases where it is necessary." <<> President Lee also stated, "Our country's property holding taxes are generally low. We will fundamentally lower the expected rate of return on real estate," and announced that a real estate tax reform plan would be unveiled in July. Regarding the rise in jeonse prices due to a decrease in jeonse supply, he said, "It is part of the normalization process." <<> Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 “도대체 납득할 수 없는 상황이 벌어지긴 했지만, 그조차도 우리 국민이 저에게 또는 이 정권에 주는 경고”라고 6·3 지방선거 결과에 관해 말했다. 더불어민주당은 16개 광역단체장 가운데 12곳에서 이겼지만, 서울시장 선거에서 패했다. 이 대통령은 “고민을 되게 많이 했다”며 “최소한 성공은 아니다. 국민들이 역시 무서운 존재구나라는 생각을 하게 됐다”고 말했다. 다만 이 대통령은 “국정 기조는 바뀔 게 없다”며 △초격차 산업 강국 △외교·안보 강국 △정상사회 △목숨 살리는 정부를 2년차 4대 국정 비전으로 제시했다.)

item.title: President Lee and Four Key Leaders Agree: "National Assembly Should Devise Major Reform Plans for Election Management" (이 대통령-4부 요인 “국회서 선거 관리 대개혁 방안 마련하자”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and the four key leaders (National Assembly Speaker, Supreme Court Chief Justice, Constitutional Court President, and Prime Minister) have agreed to have the National Assembly come up with a major reform plan for election management capable of restoring public trust, in connection with the shortage of ballot papers that erupted during the June 3 local elections. (이재명 대통령과 4부 요인(국회의장·대법원장·헌법재판소장·국무총리)이 6·3 지방선거 과정에서 불거진 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 국민적 신뢰를 회복할 수 있는 수준의 선거관리 대개혁 방안을 국회에서 마련하기로 의견을 모았다.)

President Lee and the four key leaders made this decision during a closed-door meeting at the presidential office on the afternoon of the 8th, according to Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Lee Gyu-yeon. They characterized the ballot paper shortage as a serious infringement on voting rights and agreed that a thorough investigation into the cause and the establishment of measures to prevent recurrence must be carried out swiftly. (이 대통령과 4부 요인은 8일 오후 청와대에서 비공개로 회동해 이렇게 결정했다고 이규연 청와대 홍보수석이 전했다. 이들은 투표용지 부족 사태를 중대한 참정권 침해로 규정하면서 철저한 진상규명과 재발 방지 대책 수립이 신속하게 이뤄져야 한다는 데 뜻을 같이했다.)

A presidential office official said, "All participants agreed that related legislation is necessary, but they decided to discuss which parts need to be revised and how, centered on the National Assembly." He added, "Some participants suggested that the chairperson of the National Election Commission, a part-time position, should work on a full-time basis." The meeting was attended by President Lee, National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, Constitutional Court President Kim Sang-hwan, Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. It is unusual for the four key leaders to gather over a specific issue. (청와대 관계자는 “참석하신 분들 모두 관련 입법이 필요하다는 데 의견을 같이했지만, 어느 부분을 어떻게 고쳐야 하는지는 국회를 중심으로 논의하기로 했다”며 “(비상근직인) 선관위원장이 상시로 근무하는 것이 필요하다는 의견을 제시한 분들도 있었다”고 말했다. 이날 회동에는 이 대통령과 조정식 국회의장, 김상환 헌법재판소장, 조희대 대법원장, 김민석 국무총리 등이 참석했다. 특정 사안을 두고 4부 요인이 한데 모이는 것은 이례적인 일이다.)

In his opening remarks, President Lee said, "Today, the heads of independent constitutional institutions have all gathered. I hope we can first have an official discussion on how to handle this issue," adding, "In some form, we must take appropriate responsibility from the perspective of the people, and we should also discuss what possible alternatives and measures are available." National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik stated, "As both ruling and opposition parties have submitted requests for a parliamentary investigation, we will promptly push forward a parliamentary investigation at the National Assembly level to uncover the truth." (이 대통령은 머리발언에서 “오늘 독립된 헌법기관의 책임자들이 다 모였는데 우선은 이 문제를 어떻게 다뤄야 할지 공식적인 논의를 했으면 싶다”며 “어떤 형태로든 국민 시각에서 그에 합당한 책임을 져야 할 것 같고, 어떤 가능한 대안과 대책이 있는지도 함께 논의해야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 조정식 의장은 “여야 모두 국정조사 요구서를 제출하였으므로 지체 없이 국회 차원의 국정조사를 추진해 진상규명에 나서도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

On the same day, the Democratic Party of Korea submitted to the National Assembly a "Request for a Parliamentary Investigation into the Truth of the Ballot Paper Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections and for Election Management Reform" (initiated by Floor Leader Han Byung-do), which was signed by all its lawmakers. The People Power Party also submitted a separate request for a parliamentary investigation as a party position to the National Assembly. (이날 더불어민주당은 소속 의원 모두가 이름을 올린 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 진상규명 및 선거관리개혁을 위한 국정조사 요구서’(한병도 원내대표 대표발의)를 국회에 제출했다. 국민의힘도 이날 별도의 국정조사 요구서를 당론으로 국회에 냈다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Formalizes ‘August 17 National Convention’… ‘June 3 Responsibility Debate’ Heats Up (민주 ‘8·17 전대’ 공식화…‘6·3 책임론’ 신경전 가열)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea will hold its national convention on August 17 to elect its next party leader. With Prime Minister Kim Min-seok effectively announcing his candidacy, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and Representative Song Young-gil are also expected to run. (더불어민주당이 8월17일 다음 당대표를 뽑는 전당대회를 연다. 김민석 국무총리가 사실상 출마 의사를 밝힌 가운데, 정청래 대표와 송영길 의원 등도 출마할 것으로 예상된다.)

Secretary General Jo Seung-rae held a press briefing at the National Assembly on the 8th and stated, “The Supreme Council reached a consensus to hold the regular national party convention in August, specifically on the earliest possible date, August 17.” He added, “We will form a national convention preparation committee and an election management committee, and accept candidate registrations for party leader and supreme council members. If there are four or more party leader candidates, a preliminary primary will be held before the main primary, and the leader and supreme council members will be elected through regional primaries.” With the introduction of the one-person-one-vote system starting from this national convention, competition among candidates vying for party members’ support is expected to be fierce. <<> On the same day, there was a heated debate both inside and outside the party regarding responsibility for the June 3 local elections, which saw the Seoul mayoral seat lost to the People Power Party. <<> Supreme Council member Lee Un-ju announced on Facebook that day, “Facing the results of the June 3 local elections, I deeply feel heavy responsibility,” and stated she would step down from her position as supreme council member. Within the party, this is interpreted as a move to pressure Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. A first-term lawmaker said, “It seems like a resignation aimed at saying, ‘I take responsibility for the election, so I’m stepping down, and Jeong Cheong-rae should do the same,’ given Lee’s opposing stance to Representative Jeong.” Representative Yeom Tae-young also posted on Facebook, saying, “The June 3 local elections were essentially a bitter defeat for the Democratic Party,” and pressured Representative Jeong by adding, “I recall stepping down immediately along with all the leadership as a supreme council member after the crushing defeat in the 2021 by-elections.” In response to Representative Jeong’s announcement on the 5th to form a local election evaluation committee and publish a white paper on the local elections, South Jeolla Province Governor Kim Young-rok said on MBC radio that day, “Publishing a white paper could potentially serve as a means to deflect blame,” and sharply argued, “Representative Jeong Cheong-rae must take responsibility.” <<> Representative Jeong’s side strongly refuted the theory of leadership responsibility. Secretary General Jo Seung-rae said, “The disputes surrounding the election evaluation—these were also ongoing during the election process,” and added, “Objectively speaking, failing to unify diverse voices led to regrettable results that can be called a defeat.” Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon criticized Representative Song Young-gil for making comments during the election period that seemed to defend independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, who was expelled from the party and later elected as North Jeolla Province Governor, saying, “Representative Song’s words and actions during the election process were irresponsible remarks—aren’t they a serious violation of party discipline?” Representative Choi Min-hee also expressed discomfort with Lee Un-ju’s resignation as supreme council member, posting on Facebook, “Representative Lee Un-ju, doing this in the cold weather is inappropriate.” <<> Amid this, there were also concerns about an overheated national convention. Representative Park Ji-won said on Facebook, “The competition for party leadership in the Democratic Party is escalating excessively,” and urged, “If we fail to win the general election and regain power, we’re all done. We need to find a way to hold a quiet national convention.” Another senior lawmaker said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh, “I believe the Yoon Seok-yeol administration is also part of the cause of the defeat. The proposal of a special counsel law for the cancellation of a prosecution case before the local elections, and the emphasis on strengthening real estate regulations, had a decisive impact on the election,” adding, “Can the painful aspects of the election results be resolved by criticizing specific individuals within the party?” <<> Reporters: Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr, Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr, Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (조승래 사무총장은 8일 국회에서 기자간담회를 열어 “최고위원회에서 정기 전당원대회를 8월 중 하되 가장 이른 시일인 8월17일 진행하기로 공감대가 만들어졌다”고 밝혔다. 조 사무총장은 “전당대회준비위원회와 선거관리위원회가 구성되고 당대표 후보자와 최고위원 후보자에 대한 후보 등록을 받을 것”이라며 “당대표는 4인 이상일 경우 예비경선을 거쳐 본경선을 하고, 권역별 순회 경선을 통해 대표와 최고위원을 선출하기로 했다”고 했다. 이번 전당대회 경선부터 1인 1표제가 도입돼 당원들을 향한 후보들 간 경쟁은 치열할 것으로 전망된다.)

item.title: Election Commission: Ballot shortage may extend beyond 50 polling stations (선관위 “투표용지 부족 50곳보다 더 많을 수도”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission reported to the Reform Party on the 8th that the number of polling stations experiencing ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections could increase beyond the initial 50 locations. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 투표소가 50곳에서 추가로 늘어날 가능성이 있다고 개혁신당에 8일 보고했다.)

Cheon Ha-ram, the floor leader of the Reform Party, held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day and stated, "I received a report from the Deputy Secretary-General of the National Election Commission that this ballot shortage occurred at 50 polling stations, and actual voters had to wait at 22 of those locations." He added, "The National Election Commission reported that this was based on data as of the 5th, and the number could increase further." The Election Commission had initially announced on the 3rd that 14 polling stations faced ballot shortages, then revised it to 50 on the 5th, and now indicates that this figure could also increase. (천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이번 투표용지 부족 사태가 50개 투표소에서 발생했고, 실제 투표자가 대기해서 투표해야 했던 곳은 22곳이었다고 중앙선관위 사무차장으로부터 보고받았다”며 “중앙선관위는 이것은 지난 5일 기준으로 파악된 것이고, 추후 더 늘어날 수 있다고 보고했다”고 말했다. 선관위는 지난 3일 투표용지 부족 문제가 발생한 투표소가 14곳이라고 발표했다가 이틀 뒤인 5일 50곳이라고 정정했는데 이 수치도 추가로 늘어날 가능성이 있다고 밝힌 것이다.)

According to the National Election Commission's report, a total of 67 polling stations nationwide had additional ballots sent due to concerns about shortages. Among these, actual shortages occurred at 50 polling stations. The 50 locations where ballot shortages occurred were distributed as follows: 33 in Seoul, 3 in Busan, 4 in Daegu, 6 in Incheon, 2 in Ulsan, and 2 in South Gyeongsang Province. The 22 polling stations where voter waiting occurred were located in Seoul's Songpa District (12), Gangnam District (4), Gwangjin District (2), Seocho District (1), and Incheon's Yeonsu District (3). (중앙선관위 보고 내용을 보면, 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 추가로 용지를 송부했던 투표소는 전국에 67곳이었다. 이 가운데 50곳에서 실제로 투표용지 부족이 발생했다. 투표용지 부족이 발생한 50곳은 서울 33곳, 부산 3곳, 대구 4곳, 인천 6곳, 울산 2곳, 경남 2곳이다. 대기가 발생한 투표소 22곳은 서울 송파(12곳)·강남(4곳)·광진(2곳)·서초(1곳), 인천 연수구(3곳)다.)

It has been determined that the National Election Commission only became aware of the ballot shortage situation after receiving a complaint call on election day at 4:25 PM from a voter at the 3rd polling station in Garak 2-dong, Songpa District, Seoul. This occurred after ballots had been sent to the 7th polling station in Jamsil 4-dong, Songpa District, around 2:20 PM the same day due to concerns about a shortage. The Reform Party is advocating for "selective re-elections" at the polling stations that experienced ballot shortages, and has announced it will file a "petition for partial invalidation of the Seoul district election" to pursue this. (중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태를 선거 당일 오후 4시25분 서울 송파구 가락2동 제3투표소의 민원인 전화를 받고야 알게 된 것으로 파악됐다. 당시 오후 2시20분께 송파구 잠실4동 제7투표소에서 투표용지 부족이 우려돼 투표용지가 송부된 이후다. 개혁신당은 투표용지가 부족했던 투표소에서 ‘선별적 재선거’를 치를 것을 주장하며, 이를 위해 ‘서울 관내 선거 일부 무효 소청’을 제기하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Reporters: Lee Ji-eun, Jang Na-rae, Oh Yoon-ju jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 장나래 오윤주 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Thanks 2030 Generation for Voting Station Protests, Says "You Made Us Think"… Signals Reform of Election Commission (이 대통령, 개표소 시위 2030에 “고민하게 해줘 감사”…선관위 개혁 시사)
item.description:
On the 8th, President Lee Jae-myung expressed sympathy for the voices of young people in their 20s and 30s who staged "vote-counting station blockade protests" against the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections, saying, "I also reflect a lot on the fact that they raised a fundamental issue about the exercise of sovereignty in the Republic of Korea, a democratic republic." The President stressed a policy of strong reform for the National Election Commission (NEC), stating, "I think we need to come up with fundamental measures. We were too complacent." <<> Responding to a question from a foreign journalist at a press conference marking his first year in office held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guesthouse (Yeongbingwan) on the same day, President Lee said, "Even countries with lower levels of democratic development would find this unimaginable and shocking." He continued, "In the Republic of Korea, a democratic republic, for the government to bungle the exercise of voting rights so carelessly—in crude terms—and prevent people from exercising their sovereignty, that's not just about the number of votes or the outcome; it's a very serious issue in itself. I think we've become numbed. I also felt a sense of reflection, thinking, 'Isn't this a lack of sovereignty sensitivity?'" This appears to be an effort to soothe public sentiment by actively conveying empathy for the critical awareness of the young people who raised the ballot shortage issue. President Lee added, "To be honest, I also had the thought, 'It's just a dozen or so people who couldn't vote, so it won't affect the outcome.' But they said ballot papers were insufficient from 2 p.m., and we left it unattended. I thought it was so pathetic that it made me wonder, 'Did they do it on purpose?' but I didn't approach it as a structural problem." <<> At the vote-counting station set up at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, protests demanding a re-election have been ongoing for the fourth day since the 5th, centered around young people in their 20s and 30s. They are protesting against the "violation of suffrage rights" and "undermining of fairness," and are strongly drawing a line against intervention by political forces. <<> President Lee defined their outcry as different from an "election rigging theory." He said, "I think it's entirely different: using a demonstrably false claim to build a power base through incessant agitation and brainwashing for political purposes, versus asking, 'How can people be unable to vote? In South Korea?'" <<> The President then emphasized that he would seek fundamental measures using the young people's raising of the issue as an opportunity. President Lee stated, "The NEC is an independent agency under the Constitution, so it doesn't even undergo audits by the Board of Audit and Inspection. The executive branch can only allocate budgets and approve funding for hiring, but must never interfere with how it operates. That's why I thought, 'Could there be any criminal suspicion?' and felt we at least need to get to the bottom of it. We need to know whether it was intentional or whether there are fundamental and structural problems, don't we?" The previous day, President Lee had ordered the prosecution and police to form a joint investigation headquarters to uncover the truth behind the ballot paper shortage. <<> President Lee's high regard for the critical awareness of young people regarding the ballot shortage is also interpreted as a move conscious of the youth sentiment confirmed through the results of the local elections. At the end of his related remarks, the President said once more, "We almost let this slide, but if we had, wouldn't such a thing have happened again? I am grateful to the young people who made us engage in fundamental reflection." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 8일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태에 항의해 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’를 벌이는 2030 청년들 목소리에 공감을 표하며 “민주공화국 대한민국에서 주권 행사에 대한 근본의 문제라고 제기한 것에 대해 저도 많이 반성한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “근본적인 대책을 강구해야겠다는 생각이다. 너무 안일했다”며 중앙선거관리위원회에 대한 고강도 개혁 방침을 부각했다.)

item.title: Ballot shortage polling stations double from 50 to 91 in three days... election commission's management failures 'escalating' (용지 부족 투표소 사흘 만에 50→91곳…선관위, 관리 부실 ‘점입가경’)
item.description:
The National Election Commission announced on the 8th that a total of 91 polling stations experienced ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections, and among them, 26 stations required voters to wait due to the shortage before casting their ballots. The commission initially reported 14 polling stations with insufficient ballots on the 3rd, then corrected this to 50 on the 5th, but within three days, the number of polling stations facing ballot shortages nearly doubled. (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 때 투표용지 부족 사태가 총 91개 투표소에서 발생했고, 이 가운데 투표자가 투표용지 부족 탓에 기다리다가 투표해야 했던 곳은 26곳이었다고 8일 밝혔다. 선관위는 지난 3일 투표용지가 모자랐던 투표소를 14곳으로 발표했다가 5일 50곳으로 정정했는데, 사흘 만에 투표용지 부족 투표소가 두배 가까이 늘어난 것이다.)

The locations where ballot shortages occurred included 42 in Seoul (including 20 polling stations in Songpa District), 23 in Gyeonggi Province, 11 in Incheon, 4 in Daegu, 3 in Busan, 2 in Ulsan, 1 in North Chungcheong Province, 1 in North Jeolla Province, 2 in South Jeolla Province, and 2 in South Gyeongsang Province. Among the 26 polling stations where waiting occurred, 22 were in Seoul (including 15 in Songpa District), with one each in Busan, Daegu, Incheon, and Gyeonggi Province. This suggests that the commission not only mismanaged ballot supplies but also failed to properly assess the situation afterward, with such evidence continuing to emerge. (투표용지 부족이 발생한 곳은 서울 송파구 투표소 20곳을 포함해 서울이 42곳, 경기 23곳, 인천 11곳, 대구 4곳, 부산 3곳, 울산 2곳, 충북 1곳, 전북 1곳, 전남 2곳, 경남 2곳이었다. 대기가 발생한 투표소 26곳은 송파구 15곳을 포함한 서울 22곳, 부산·대구·인천·경기 1곳씩이다. 선관위가 투표용지 관리 미흡은 물론 이후 사태 현황 파악도 제대로 못 했다는 정황이 계속해서 드러나고 있는 셈이다.)

In response, the National Election Commission stated, "We apologize for the delay in quickly and accurately grasping the situation," and added, "The fact-finding committee will investigate whether there are additional polling stations with ballot shortages." The commission announced that it will form and operate a 'Ballot Shortage Fact-Finding Committee' for ten days starting from the 10th. It was revealed that the commission only became aware of the ballot shortage at 4:25 PM on the 3rd, the election day, after receiving a call from a voter at the 3rd polling station in Garak 2-dong, Songpa District, Seoul. (이에 대해 중앙선관위는 “신속하고 정확한 현황 파악이 늦어진 점에 대해 사과한다”며 “투표용지 부족 투표소가 추가로 있는지 등은 진상규명위원회가 조사할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 중앙선관위는 오는 10일부터 열흘 간 ‘투표용지 부족사태 진상규명위원회’를 구성해 운영한다고 밝혔다. 중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족 사태를 지난 3일 선거 당일 오후 4시25분 서울 송파구 가락2동 제3투표소의 민원인 전화를 받고야 알게 된 것으로 파악됐다.)

Meanwhile, the North Chungcheong Provincial Election Commission belatedly issued an apology on the same day, stating, "At around 6:10 AM on the 3rd, we confirmed that the names of 1,295 voters were omitted from the electoral register placed at the Seonghwa Gaesin Jungnim-dong 5th polling station, and we replaced it with a complete electoral register 30 minutes later to proceed with voting. It is estimated that one or two individuals ultimately could not vote." (한편 충북도선관위는 이날 “지난 3일 아침 6시10분께 성화개신죽림동 5투표소에 비치된 선거인명부에서 유권자 1295명의 이름이 누락된 것을 확인하고, 30분 뒤 누락 없는 선거인 명부로 대체해 투표를 진행했다”며 “최종 1~2명 정도가 투표하지 못한 것으로 추정된다”고 뒤늦게 사과문을 냈다.)

By Jang Narae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Xi Jinping visits North Korea for first time in 7 years… “Strengthen diplomatic, legal, and military exchanges with North Korea” (시진핑 7년 만에 방북…“북한과 외교·법·군사 교류 강화”)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed to comprehensively strengthen strategic cooperation within a new international order during a summit held in Pyongyang on the 8th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장과 시진핑 중국 국가주석이 8일 평양에서 한 정상회담에서 새로운 국제질서 속에서 전략적 협력을 전면 강화하기로 했다.)

President Xi, visiting North Korea for the first time in seven years, said at a meeting with Chairman Kim held at the Kumsusan Guesthouse in Pyongyang that day, “We intend to maintain close strategic communication and continuously develop China-North Korea relations to a new level,” according to China’s state-run Xinhua News Agency. President Xi particularly emphasized, “We will strengthen the linkage of development strategies (between North Korea and China),” adding, “Taking the full reopening of border crossings, civil aviation flights, and international passenger train services as an opportunity, we should expand personnel exchanges and realize two-way exchanges.” This signals a comprehensive expansion of economic cooperation between North Korea and China. President Xi also highlighted strengthening military and diplomatic cooperation, stating, “We will strengthen exchanges in diplomatic, law enforcement, and military fields.” Chairman Kim responded, “We will make the development of North Korea-China relations the nation’s most important primary strategic project.” There was no mention of issues concerning the Korean Peninsula, such as North Korea’s denuclearization. <<> President Xi, accompanied by his wife Peng Liyuan, arrived in Pyongyang around noon that day, beginning a two-day state visit to North Korea. Chairman Kim Jong-un and his wife Ri Sol-ju greeted President Xi and his wife at the airport. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (7년 만에 방북한 시 주석은 이날 평양 금수산 영빈관에서 열린 김 위원장과의 회담에서 “긴밀한 전략적 소통을 유지하며 중-조(북-중) 관계를 지속적으로 새로운 수준으로 발전시키고자 한다”고 말했다고 중국 관영 신화통신이 보도했다. 시 주석은 특히 “(북-중) 발전 전략 연계를 강화하겠다”며 “국경 통상구의 전면 재개통과 민항 항공편, 국제 여객열차 운행 재개를 계기로 인적 교류를 확대하고 쌍방향 교류를 실현해야 한다”고 말했다. 북-중 간 전면적인 경제협력 확대를 예고한 것이다. 시 주석은 또 “외교, 법 집행, 군사 분야의 교류를 강화하겠다”며 군사·외교 협력 강화도 부각했다. 김 위원장도 “조-중 관계 발전을 국가의 가장 중대한 제1전략사업으로 삼을 것”이라고 답했다. 북한 비핵화 등 한반도 문제는 전혀 언급되지 않았다.)

item.title: Promoting a 'Multipolar' Order to Counter US Hegemony: North Korea-China Relations Upgraded to 'Strategic Partners' (미국 패권에 맞선 ‘다극화’ 추진…북-중 ‘전략적 동반자’로 격상)
item.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping, visiting North Korea for the first time in seven years, and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un agreed on the 8th at the Pyongyang summit to fully restore North Korea-China relations and elevate them to a new stage as 'strategic partners.' The two leaders decided to significantly strengthen economic exchanges between the two countries, including the full resumption of customs operations, and also hinted at the possibility of military cooperation. Any mention of 'denuclearization' was completely absent. (7년 만에 북한을 방문한 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 김정은 국무위원장이 8일 평양 정상회담에서 북-중 관계를 전면 복원하고 ‘전략적 동반자’라는 새로운 단계로 나아가기로 했다. 두 정상은 통관의 전면적 재개를 비롯해 양국의 경제 교류를 대폭 강화하고, 군사적 협력 가능성도 시사했다. ‘비핵화’ 언급은 완전히 사라졌다.)

China's state-run Xinhua News Agency reported that Chairman Kim Jong-un, during his summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping at the Kumsusan Guest House in Pyongyang, defined North Korea-China relations as "the most important and foremost strategic project of the state" and emphasized that "consolidating and developing DPRK-China (North Korea-China) friendship in the new era is the choice of the people and the demand of the times." Chairman Kim stated, "We will continue to uphold the One-China principle without change and firmly support China's policies and positions in safeguarding its core interests." This clearly expressed his intention to support China's stance on defending core interests, including the Taiwan issue. <<> President Xi also emphasized to Chairman Kim, "Through this visit, we aim to strengthen the top-level design and strategic guidance of DPRK-China (North Korea-China) relations in the new era, promoting the development of these relations with the times to achieve greater progress." The two leaders also presented four proposals: strengthening political trust through high-level exchanges, enhancing practical cooperation to improve people's welfare, deepening ties driven by friendly traditions, and reinforcing strategic cooperation. <<> A particularly notable part was when President Xi said, "We should expand personnel exchanges and realize two-way exchanges by taking the full reopening of border trade ports, the resumption of civil aviation routes, and the operation of international passenger trains as an opportunity." This signaled a comprehensive expansion of economic cooperation between the two countries, including the opening of the new Yalu River Bridge between North Korea's Sinuiju and China's Dandong, which has remained unopened for over a decade since its completion. President Xi also stated, "We will strengthen the alignment of development strategies between the two countries," which is interpreted as heralding an expansion of economic cooperation on a different scale from China's past aid to North Korea. <<> The two leaders also emphasized military and diplomatic cooperation. President Xi noted, "This year marks the 65th anniversary of the signing of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance," and said, "The two sides should strengthen exchanges in diplomacy, law enforcement, and the military, properly implement important consensus, and pool wisdom and strength for the development of DPRK-China relations." <<> Earlier, in a bylined article published on the front page of the North Korean Workers' Party newspaper Rodong Sinmun on this day of his visit, President Xi highlighted that North Korea and China "firmly support the defense of national sovereignty, security, and development interests, and must jointly uphold the post-war international order," emphasizing that the North Korea-China relationship is an important partnership operating at the level of the international order, transcending the Korean Peninsula and engaging with US-China competition and North Korea-China-Russia cooperation. President Xi stated, "We oppose hegemonism and power politics, and oppose all ambitions and schemes that seek the revival of militarism and threaten regional security and stability," adding, "Let us jointly promote the multipolarization of the world and economic globalization." The 'multipolarization of the world' mentioned by President Xi is China's foreign strategy challenging US hegemony. The phrase 'opposing the revival of militarism' is interpreted as a call to jointly oppose Japan's rearmament. <<> In the North Korea-China summit and President Xi's article, there was no mention whatsoever of North Korea's denuclearization, inter-Korean relations, or other Korean Peninsula issues. This contrasts with Xi's 2019 visit to North Korea, when he positively assessed North Korea-US dialogue in his article and mentioned the 'Korean Peninsula' six times. This can be seen as an indication that 'denuclearization' is no longer a priority in North Korea-China relations, effectively acquiescing to North Korea's demand for recognition as a nuclear-armed state. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, analyzed, "This is a signal that China's paradigm for approaching North Korea has completely shifted from a 'mediator for North Korea-US denuclearization' to a 'tightly knit strategic partner for structural checks on the US.'" <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee: minggu@hani.co.kr (중국 관영 신화통신은 이날 김정은 위원장이 평양 금수산 영빈관에서 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 정상회담을 하면서 북-중 관계를 “국가의 가장 중대한 제1전략사업”으로 규정하고 “새 시대 조-중(북한과 중국) 우호를 공고히 하고 발전시키는 것은 인민의 선택이자 시대의 요구”라고 강조했다고 보도했다. 김 위원장은 “앞으로도 변함없이 하나의 중국 원칙을 견지하고 중국이 핵심 이익을 수호하기 위해 취하는 정책과 입장을 확고히 지지할 것”이라고 말했다. 대만 문제를 비롯한 중국의 핵심 이익 수호 입장을 지지하겠다는 의사를 분명히 한 것이다.)

item.title: North Korean Media: "New Milestone in North Korea-China Strategic Relations… Satisfactory Consensus Reached" (북 매체 “북·중 전략적 관계 새 이정표…만족한 견해 일치”)
item.description:
The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 9th that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, and Chinese President Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China and President of the People's Republic of China, agreed at a summit in Pyongyang to develop bilateral relations into a strategic partnership and expand exchanges and cooperation in various fields. (김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장과 시진핑 중국공산당 중앙위원회 총서기 겸 국가주석이 평양에서 한 정상회담에서 양자가 전략적 관계로 발전하고, 각 분야별 교류와 협력을 확대하기로 했다고 조선중앙통신이 9일 보도했다.)

KCNA reported that at the meeting held the previous day at the Kumsusan Guest House, Chairman Kim stated, "The Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) will continue to uphold DPRK-China friendship as the most important and primary strategic task, and will make every effort to strengthen and develop bilateral relations into a model of relations between socialist countries, a special, genuine, and unshakable strategic relationship." (조선중앙통신은 전날 금수산영빈관에서 열린 회담에서 김 위원장이 “조선노동당과 조선민주주의인민공화국(북한) 정부는 앞으로도 조중(북중) 친선을 가장 중대한 제1의 전략적 사업으로 견지하고 두 나라 관계를 사회주의 국가 간 관계의 본보기로, 변색될 수 없는 특수하고 진실하며 공고한 전략적 관계로 강화 발전시키기 위해 모든 노력을 다할 것”이라고 말했다고 전했다.)

Regarding the Taiwan issue, Chairman Kim also said, "No matter how the situation changes, our party and government will fully support and endorse the policies and positions of the Chinese party and government aimed at safeguarding core interests based on the 'One China' principle." When a North Korea-China summit was held in Beijing last September to mark the 80th anniversary of China's Victory Day, North Korean media did not report any mention of the cross-strait issue. (김 위원장은 대만 문제에 대해서도 “정세가 어떻게 변하든 우리 당과 정부는 ‘하나의 중국’ 원칙에 입각해 핵심이익을 수호하기 위한 중국당과 정부의 정책과 입장을 전적으로 지지 성원할 것”이라고 했다. 지난해 9월 중국 전승절 80주년을 맞아 베이징에서 북-중 정상회담이 열렸을 당시엔 북한 매체들이 양안 문제에 대한 언급을 보도하지 않았다.)

KCNA stated that Chairman Kim and President Xi agreed to "further strengthen strategic communication through high-level exchanges between the two parties and two countries, expand and develop exchanges and cooperation in political, economic, cultural, and other fields, and open a new chapter in the development of DPRK-China relations." They also agreed to hold commemorative events to mark the 65th anniversary of the DPRK-China Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, scheduled for July 11. (통신은 김 위원장과 시 주석이 “두 당, 두 나라 사이의 고위급 래왕(왕래)을 통한 전략적 의사소통을 더욱 긴밀히 하고 정치, 경제, 문화 등 각 분야에서의 교류와 협력을 보다 확대 발전시켜 조중관계의 발전의 새로운 장”을 열기로 합의했다고 했다. 또 7월11일로 예정된 북중 우호협력조약 체결 65주년을 계기로 기념행사를 개최하기로 했다.)

KCNA also reported that "exchanges of views on international and regional issues took place" during the meeting, and that discussions were held on "strengthening strategic coordination and cooperation between the two parties and two countries amid the complex and multifaceted global political situation, firmly safeguarding the sovereignty, security, and development interests of both countries, and jointly maintaining peace and development in the region and the world." This appears to pertain to discussions on the Korean Peninsula and international affairs, and KCNA noted that "a satisfactory consensus was reached" between the two leaders. However, like the previous day's report from China's Xinhua News Agency, North Korean media did not mention denuclearization. (회담에서는 또 “국제 및 지역문제들에 대한 의견교환이 진행됐다”며 “복잡다단한 세계정치 정세 속에서 조중 두 당, 두 나라 사이의 전략적 조정과 협력을 강화하고 양국의 주권과 안전, 발전이익을 굳건히 고수하며 지역과 세계의 평화와 발전을 공동으로 수호”하는 문제에 대해 논의했다고 통신은 보도했다. 이는 한반도와 국제정세에 대한 논의로 보이며, 두 정상 사이엔 “만족한 견해일치가 이룩됐다”고 통신은 밝혔다. 다만 전날 중국 신화통신 보도와 마찬가지로 북 매체도 비핵화 관련 언급은 하지 않았다.)

Xinhua and other outlets reported that President Xi would strengthen exchanges with North Korea in areas such as diplomacy, law enforcement, and the military, but KCNA did not report these remarks either. (신화통신 등은 시 주석이 북한과 외교·법 집행·군대 등 분야의 교류를 강화할 것이라고 보도했지만, 조선중앙통신은 이런 발언도 보도하지 않았다.)

Furthermore, KCNA emphasized that this meeting served as "a historical occasion that clearly demonstrated the immutability of DPRK-China friendship, which has been continuously consolidated and developed through joint struggles for the socialist cause, and set a new milestone in the development of strategic cooperative relations between the two parties and two countries." (아울러 조선중앙통신은 이번 회담이 “사회주의 위업 수행을 위한 공동의 투쟁 속에서 끊임없이 공고 발전되어 온 조중친선의 불변성을 뚜렷이 과시하고 두 당, 두 나라 사이의 전략적 협조 관계 발전의 새로운 이정표를 세운 역사적인 계기”라고 강조했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "A re-election cannot be held unless there is a serious violation... Jang Dong-hyuk's path has failed" (오세훈 “중대 위법 아니면 재선거 못 해…장동혁 노선은 실패”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon expressed a negative stance on the 're-election' for the June 3 local elections demanded by People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk and others, stating, "I understand the political engineering interests, but the law stipulates that a re-election cannot be held unless there is a serious procedural flaw that could alter the outcome." (오세훈 서울시장이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 등이 요구 중인 6·3 지방선거 ‘재선거’에 대해 “정치공학적인 이해관계는 이해하지만, 절차상 하자가 당락을 바꿀 만한 중대한 위법이 아니면 재선거는 치를 수 없도록 돼 있다”며 부정적 입장을 밝혔다.)

Mayor Oh made these remarks in an interview with the 'Chosun Ilbo' published on the 9th. Regarding the shortage of ballot papers that sparked the demand for a re-election, he said, "It is an absolutely unacceptable situation. I said in a recent public address that 'all powerful measures that the public can accept must be mobilized to uncover the truth,'" but added, "However, as the head of the Seoul Metropolitan Government's administration, I cannot add anything beyond that statement." (오 시장은 9일 공개된 ‘조선일보’와의 인터뷰에서 이같이 밝혔다. 오 시장은 재선거 요구의 원인이 된 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해 “도저히 있을 수 없는 일이다. 얼마 전 대시민 담화에서 ‘국민이 납득할 수 있는 모든 강력한 수단을 동원해 진상을 규명해야 한다’고 밝혔다”면서도 “다만 서울시 행정 책임자로서 담화문 이상의 말을 보탤 수 없다”고 했다.)

On the demand for a 're-election,' he drew a line, saying, "I believe there are some politicians who want the Seoul mayoral re-election to happen again," adding, "I fully understand the political engineering interests, but the Public Official Election Act strictly stipulates that a full re-election cannot be held unless a procedural flaw in the election administration is a serious violation that could change the outcome." Chairman Jang is calling for a nationwide re-election, including Seoul. (‘재선거’ 요구에 대해선 “서울시장 재선거가 다시 열리기를 원하는 정치인들도 일부 있을 것으로 본다”며 “정치공학적인 이해관계는 충분히 이해하지만, 공직선거법에는 선거 행정 절차상의 하자가 당락을 바꿀 만한 중대한 위법이 아니라면 전면적인 재선거는 치를 수 없도록 엄격하게 명시돼 있다”며 선을 그었다. 장 대표는 서울을 포함한 전국 단위의 재선거 실시를 촉구 중이다.)

Regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, Mayor Oh claimed, "It means that the path Chairman Jang advocates has failed." He continued, "Now, the People Power Party is at a crossroads: either advance into the rough sea of the center or degenerate into a 'YouTube party' that only scratches where the hardcore supporters itch," adding, "It is now time for PPP lawmakers to decide whether they will fight next year's general election on this current path." (오 시장은 이번 6·3 지방선거의 결과를 두고 “장 대표가 지향하는 노선이 실패했다는 의미”라고 주장했다. 이어 “지금 국민의힘은 중도의 거친 바다로 나아가느냐, 아니면 강성 지지층의 가려운 곳만 긁어주는 ‘유튜브 정당’으로 전락하느냐 기로에 섰다”며 “이제는 국민의힘 의원들도 지금의 노선으로 내후년 총선을 치를 것인지 결단해야 할 시점”이라고 했다.)

On the view that Chairman Jang should resign, he said, "Whether he holds on to the leadership position until the end or steps down, it has become difficult to receive applause no matter what choice he makes now," adding, "Yet Chairman Jang cannot now reverse the political path oriented toward hardcore supporters." He further added, "I think it will be difficult for Chairman Jang to act as a variable in the future conservative political landscape." (장 대표가 사퇴해야 한다는 시각에 대해선 “대표직에서 끝까지 버티든지 아니면 물러나든지 이제는 어떤 선택을 해도 박수받기 어렵게 됐다”며 “그렇다고 장 대표는 강성 지지층을 지향하는 정치적 노선을 이제 와서 돌이킬 수도 없다”고 했다. 이어 “장 대표가 향후 보수 정국의 변수로 작용하기는 어렵다고 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Song Kyung-hwa, Reporter freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Departs for G7 Summit... Interest in Whether He Will Meet Trump on 16-17 (이 대통령, G7 정상회의 위해 출국…16~17일 트럼프 만날지 관심)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung departed on the 9th to attend the Group of Seven (G7) summit and other engagements. (이재명 대통령이 9일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석 등을 위해 출국했다.)

The President departed around 9 a.m. from Seoul Airport in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, aboard the presidential jet, heading to Brussels, Belgium. At the airport, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, Minister of the Interior and Safety Yoon Ho-jung, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, and Senior Political Secretary Hong Ik-pyo were present to see him off. Party leadership, including Democratic Party of Korea leader Jeong Cheong-rae, did not attend the send-off event. This is unusual, as party leaders typically personally escort the president when he departs on overseas trips. <<> The presidential office stated, "Given the prolonged Middle East war and domestic situations such as the mismanagement of the election commission, we minimized the number of send-off attendees, including personnel from the presidential office and the cabinet." <<> From today through the 18th, President Lee will visit Belgium, Italy, the Vatican, and France. According to the presidential office, this aims to expand Korea's diplomatic horizons into Europe, engage in major international issues, and establish its status as a globally responsible nation. <<> For his first schedule, the President will arrive in Brussels, Belgium, this evening (local time) and hold a dinner meeting with compatriots. The next day, he will hold a summit with Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever and, in the afternoon, meet with King Philippe. He will then hold summits with European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. <<> On the 10th, President Lee will move to Rome, and the following day, the 11th, he will carry out a state visit schedule upon the invitation of Italian President Sergio Mattarella. This is President Lee's first visit to Italy since his inauguration. During the Italy visit, summits are scheduled with President Mattarella and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, and a 'Korea-Italy Business Round Table' will seek to boost bilateral corporate exchanges. <<> Following the state visit custom of visiting provincial cities, President Lee will travel to Florence to meet with the mayor and discuss ways to strengthen cultural cooperation. After completing the state visit schedule, the President plans to visit the Vatican on the 14th and 15th. On the 14th, he will attend a special Mass for peace and solidarity at St. Paul's Basilica, and on the 15th, meet with Pope Leo XIV and Cardinal Secretary of State Pietro Carolin. National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing on the 5th, "Through the special Mass, the President's speech will express Korea's will for global peace and solidarity amid rapidly changing international circumstances and seek support from the Vatican." <<> As his final schedule, President Lee will attend the Group of Seven summit held in Évian, France, on the 16th and 17th. The presidential office stated that attending the summit for the second consecutive year is expected to solidify its status as a G7-plus global responsible power. As U.S. President Donald Trump will also attend the summit, there is interest in whether a Korea-U.S. summit will be arranged. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 오전 9시께 경기 성남시 서울공항에서 대통령 전용기를 타고 벨기에 브뤼셀로 출발했다. 공항에는 김민석 국무총리와 윤호중 행정안전부 장관, 강훈식 대통령 비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석 등이 배웅을 나왔다. 정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 등 당 지도부는 환송 행사에 나오지 않았다. 통상 당 대표가 대통령 순방 출국 시 직접 배웅을 해왔던 것을 고려하면 이례적인 장면이다. )

item.title: Im Mi-ae: "The Democratic Party ran a very lazy campaign... It wasn't just because of conservative consolidation." (임미애 “민주, 매우 게으른 선거…보수 결집 때문 아냐”)
item.description:
<<>> Im Mi-ae, a lawmaker who serves as the chair of the Democratic Party of Korea's Gyeongsangbuk-do provincial committee, said of the June 3 local elections, "The Democratic Party lost. From the perspective of Daegu and Gyeongsangbuk-do, it was a strategic failure." <<> In a post on her Facebook page late on the night of the 8th, Rep. Im then noted, "Three-quarters of voters in Daegu and Gyeongsangbuk-do did not vote for Lee Jae-myung in the last presidential election, and in their eyes, no matter how well the Lee Jae-myung government performs, there was no reason for the Democratic Party to also take more parliamentary seats or local power." She pointed out that "the controversy over the special counsel bill on fabricated indictments or the Starbucks incident that erupted during the campaign fueled suspicions that 'the Democratic Party is trying to abuse its power.'"
